info.prompt: Dramatic cinematic shot of the **Neo-Gothic Bio-Architecture** interface mid-transition — the **Ivory Sanctuary** lobby shatters into obsidian shards as **liquid gold circulatory lines** fracture into **bioluminescent cyan neural glows**, revealing the **10x10 grid** beneath with **Wild Blockers** emitting rainbow hue-rotating rings. Player avatars hover as **deterministic geometric formations** derived from FNV-1a hashes, while a **Rainbow Bomb** countdown pulses prismatic light across **skeletal gold filigree** borders. The **terminal-style hacker overlay** scrolls SHA-256 seed verification glyphs, and **synth arpeggios** manifest as floating **electric magenta waveforms** in the negative space.
